about.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Pixel Apps is a forward-thinking digital products company dedicated to creating smart, simple, and impactful software experiences. We specialize in next-generation AI tools, productivity apps, and utility solutions designed to empower users and businesses worldwide.

With a strong focus on innovation, design excellence, and user-first experiences, Pixel Apps continues to push the boundaries of what technology can do—turning powerful ideas into everyday solutions that make life easier, faster, and more intelligent.

faq.title: Your Questions, Answered
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most common questions about our AI services

items.question: What is AI automation and how can it help my business?
items.answer: AI automation uses intelligent systems to handle repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and improve efficiency—allowing you to focus on growth and innovation.

items.question: How long does it take to build a custom solution?
items.answer: Most projects take 4–8 weeks, depending on complexity and your specific requirements.

items.question: Can you integrate AI with my existing systems?
items.answer: Yes, we design AI solutions that seamlessly connect with your current tools and workflows.

items.question: What industries benefit most from your solutions?
items.answer: Our AI tools work across industries including retail, healthcare, logistics, finance, education, and more.

items.question: How do I get started with an AI-powered business upgrade?
items.answer: Simply contact our team—we’ll assess your needs, create a plan, and start building your solution.

This Privacy Policy applies to the AI Chatbot: Ask AI Assistant application (“Application”) for mobile devices, developed and provided by Pixel Apps SMC PVT LTD. (“Service Provider”, “we”, “us”, or “our”). The Application is provided as a freemium service and is intended for use “AS IS.”
Information Collection and Use
The Service Provider does not directly collect, store, or maintain users’ personal data on its own servers through the Application.

The Application may use third-party services to provide certain functionality. When you use features that rely on these services, certain information may be processed directly by the applicable third-party service provider in accordance with its own privacy policy.
Depending on the services and features used, this information may include technical information such as:

items: Information or content voluntarily submitted by the user when using a feature powered by a third-party service.

blocks.text: The Service Provider does not independently store this information on its own servers unless explicitly stated otherwise.
AI Features and User-Provided Content
Certain features of the Application may use third-party artificial intelligence services.

When a user submits text, prompts, questions, documents, images, or other content to an AI-powered feature, the information necessary to process the request may be transmitted directly to the relevant third-party service provider.

Such information is processed for the purpose of providing the requested functionality. Processing, storage, and retention by third-party providers are governed by their respective privacy policies and terms.
Users should avoid submitting sensitive personal information through AI prompts or other input fields unless necessary for the requested functionality.
Face Data
The Application does not collect, process, store, retain, or share face data or facial biometric information.
The Application does not currently provide features that require facial recognition, facial analysis, or the processing of face data.
Location Information
The Application does not collect or track the precise geographic location of your mobile device.
Third-Party Services

The Application may rely on third-party services for functionality such as artificial intelligence processing, subscriptions and payments, analytics, crash reporting, cloud-based functionality, or other supporting services.
These third parties may process certain information according to their own privacy policies and terms.
The Service Provider does not sell users’ personal information.
Where information is transmitted directly to a third-party service as part of a feature requested by the user, the third party’s processing practices are governed by its applicable privacy policy.
Payments and Subscriptions

If the Application offers subscriptions or in-app purchases through an application marketplace such as the Apple App Store or Google Play, payment transactions are processed by the applicable marketplace or payment provider.
The Service Provider does not directly receive or store users’ complete payment card or banking information through the Application.
Data Retention

Because the Service Provider does not directly collect or store personal information on its own servers through the Application, it generally does not maintain a separate retention period for such information.
Information processed by third-party service providers may be retained according to their respective privacy policies and retention practices.

If you contact the Service Provider directly, for example by email, information contained in your communication may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your request, maintain appropriate business records, comply with legal obligations, or resolve disputes.
Data Deletion
Because the Application does not directly maintain user personal data on the Service Provider’s servers, there may be no application-specific personal data stored by us to delete.
If you have contacted us directly or believe that we possess personal information relating to you, you may contact us at info@pixelappspk.com to request information or deletion, where applicable.
Information processed independently by third-party service providers may be subject to the deletion procedures and policies of those providers.
Children’s Privacy
The Service Provider does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13.

If you are a parent or legal guardian and believe that a child has provided personal information directly to the Service Provider, please contact us at info@pixelappspk.com, and we will take appropriate steps to address the request.
Users must meet the minimum age requirements applicable in their country or obtain any required consent from a parent or legal guardian.
Security
The Service Provider takes reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect information associated with the Application.
However, because certain Application features may communicate with third-party services over the internet, no electronic transmission or processing method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Third-party service providers are responsible for protecting information processed through their respective systems in accordance with their own security practices and privacy policies.
Your Choices
You may stop using the Application at any time by uninstalling it from your device.
You may also choose not to use features that require information to be transmitted to third-party services.
Where applicable, device permissions can be managed through your device’s operating system settings.
Disclosure Required by Law

The Service Provider may disclose information in its possession if required to do so by applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or when reasonably necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of the Service Provider, its users, or others.
Changes to This Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time to reflect changes to the Application, third-party services, legal requirements, or our privacy practices.

Any updated Privacy Policy will be made available through the Application or the location where this Privacy Policy is published. The effective date shown at the top of this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.
Users are encouraged to review this Privacy Policy periodically.
Your Consent
By using the Application, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or the privacy practices of the Application, please contact:
Pixel Apps SMC PVT LTD.
Email: info@pixelappspk.com
